CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sf_user_data_cache (
          user_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
          channel_id TEXT,
          org_id TEXT,
          team_id TEXT,
          data TEXT NOT NULL,
          etag TEXT,
          updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
          expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL
        );
ALTER TABLE sf_user_data_cache ADD COLUMN etag TEXT

INSERT INTO sf_user_data_cache (user_id, channel_id, org_id, team_id, data, etag, updated_at, expires_at)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
      ON CONFLICT(user_id) DO UPDATE SET
        channel_id = excluded.channel_id,
        org_id = excluded.org_id,
        team_id = excluded.team_id,
        data = excluded.data,
        etag = excluded.etag,
        updated_at = excluded.updated_at,
        expires_at = excluded.expires_at
